h1: Custom Midweight Caps for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom midweight caps in bulk. Durable, comfortable, and ideal for year-round wear. Get a quote from Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Midweight caps strike the perfect balance between lightweight summer hats and heavy winter beanies. Made from a substantial cotton or cotton-blend fabric, they hold their shape well and provide enough warmth for spring and fall events without overheating. For corporate giveaways, trade shows, or employee uniforms, midweight caps offer a professional look that works across seasons. Choose from structured or unstructured styles and decorate with embroidery or screen printing for a crisp, long-lasting logo.
heroAltText: Stack of custom midweight caps in assorted colors for corporate branding
